summary: The Bar-goal divergence is a macro evaluation-order defect. In sp_lev.c:sp_amask_to_amask, the AM_SPLEV_NONCO branch passes noncoalignment(...) to Align2amask. The C macro references its argument in two comparisons and the fallback addition, so the random call can run once, twice, or three times according to short-circuit results. js/themeroom_fill.js currently invokes noncoalignment once and computes the mask from that single result.

source.branch: sp_amask_to_amask when sp_amask == AM_SPLEV_NONCO for a special-level monster or altar. The original alignment u.ualignbase[A_ORIGINAL] is passed to noncoalignment; Align2amask then reevaluates that side-effecting expression at each macro reference.
callers: sp_lev.c:create_monster:1943 passes m->sp_amask to sp_amask_to_amask before monster construction.
sp_lev.c:lspo_altar:2469 passes a->sp_amask to sp_amask_to_amask after set_levltyp succeeds.
js/themeroom_fill.js:createMonsterBody:557 resolves the monster descriptor alignment through sp_amask_to_amask.
js/mklev.js:altar creation around 1402 resolves the altar descriptor through sp_amask_to_amask.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/include/align.h:50-53 defines Align2amask as a nested conditional macro whose x expression occurs up to three times; its short-circuit order is part of the observed behavior.

evidence: Accepted evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-9cf6135e96ef404438d1de92579e412f0fc024f7-v36.json at 9cf6135e96ef404438d1de92579e412f0fc024f7 retains the same recording identity and reports 43/60 screens, 2303/3365 RNG calls, and 60/60 cursors; the current queue still lists 17 remaining screens.

The saved focused comparison .cache/B198/admitted-comparison.json identifies the first RNG mismatch at segment 0, step 19, key A, index 2293: C rn2(2)=0 from noncoalignment(sp_lev.c:1856), while JavaScript has rnd(2)=1. At step 43 the first screen mismatch is row 5, column 32 (C '^' and JS '.').

Upstream sp_lev.c:1908-1921 contains the complete source function. Lines 1914-1915 select AM_SPLEV_NONCO and call Align2amask(noncoalignment(u.ualignbase[A_ORIGINAL])); noncoalignment at sp_lev.c:1852-1860 calls rn2(2) once per invocation.

Upstream include/align.h:50-53 expands x in the A_NONE comparison, then the A_LAWFUL comparison if needed, then the final x + 2 expression if neither matched. Its repeated evaluations explain the second C draw at index 2293.

The corresponding JavaScript function is js/themeroom_fill.js:836-853. Its AM_SPLEV_NONCO arm currently calls noncoalignment once before the alignment conversion. Production callers are js/themeroom_fill.js:createMonsterBody and js/mklev.js altar placement; the admitted Bar-goal recording exercises the altar path.
